milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate to within proximity of the farmland patch (centered at spawn-relative [6, -1, 4]) and be facing toward it. The farmland is ~7 blocks diagonally from spawn, so max_distance=8 ensures the player has actively navigated toward the farm rather than triggering from spawn. Facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the farmland (has 'found' it visually).
